item.title: Russian attacks against Ukraine kill 4, injure 21, including children, over past day
item.description: Ukrainian forces downed 76 out of the 90 drones, including Shahed-type attack drones, launched by Russia overnight, the Air Force reported. Fourteen drones struck nine different locations, according to the statement.

item.title: Russia steps up attacks with Kh-32 missiles — here's what we know

item.title: Ukraine sees 'real results' from blocking Russia’s Starlink use, defense minister says
item.description: Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov said a system would soon be introduced to ensure only authorized terminals can operate in Ukraine. Unverified terminals will be disabled.

item.title: Where martial law meets the energy crisis | Ukraine This Week
item.description: In the latest episode of Ukraine This Week, the Kyiv Independent’s Anna Belokur explains how martial law shapes daily life in Ukraine amid the country's harshest winter since the full-scale invasion.

item.title: Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia injure at least 9, maternity hospital damaged
item.description: Russian troops launched two attacks on the southern city of Zaporizhzhia on Feb. 1, injuring at least nine people, including a child, Governor Ivan Fedorov said.

item.title: Ukraine, US, Russia to meet in UAE next week for new round of peace talks, Zelensky says
item.description: Ukraine, the U.S., and Russia are set to meet in Abu Dhabi on Feb. 4-5 for a new round of talks as part of ongoing efforts to negotiate a peace deal, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Feb. 1.

item.title: 'Not enough' work being done in Kyiv as city faces heating emergency, Zelensky says
item.description: "Whether there are strikes or not, hundreds of buildings in Kyiv are still without heating. This means that the work being done in the city is not enough."

item.title: 'Unprovoked terrorist strike' — Russia attacks bus carrying Ukrainian civilian miners, killing at least 12, injuring 16
item.description: Russia launched a mass attack, targeting mines of DTEK, Ukraine's biggest private energy firm, the company said. One of the strikes hit a service bus in the town of Ternivka, which was transporting miners after their shift.

item.title: Explosions, fire reported overnight in Russia's Belgorod region
item.description: Explosions were reported overnight Feb. 2 in Russia's Belgorod region, where officials said an alleged Ukrainian drone attack sparked a fire in the city of Stary Oskol.
